2610.13273.title: Agent4Spec: An LLM-based Agentic System to Optimize API Specifications through Automated Validation and Market Analysis
2610.13273.paper_summary: API specifications serve as critical documentation for modern software development, directly impacting integration efficiency and client code generation. While recent advancements have leveraged Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate initial specifications from source code, existing approaches treat this process as a one-time event - overlooking the needs for continuous validation, long-term maintenance, and market-driven evolution of these artifacts. To address this issue, we present Agent4Spec, an autonomous multi-agent framework featuring two distinct pipelines: (1) a validation pipeline that detects and self-corrects OpenAPI syntax errors, and (2) a market analysis pipeline that conducts competitive research, identifies functional gaps against industry leaders, and automatically generates missing API-spec functionalities. We evaluate Agent4Spec on two curated datasets of API specifications spanning both general-purpose and industrial scenarios. Among 9 SOTA LLMs, the top-performer achieves 100% syntax error detection rates and over 95% implementation success for proposed corrections, while securing over 50% adoption rates for suggested endpoint improvements, representing a practical tool for API development.
2610.13273.paper_summary_zh: API 規範作為現代軟體開發的重要文件，直接影響整合效率和客戶代碼生成。雖然最近的進展利用大型語言模型 (LLMs) 從源代碼生成初始規範，但現有的方法將這一過程視為一次性事件——忽視了對這些文檔進行持續驗證、長期維護和市場驅動演變的需求。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了 Agent4Spec，一個自主的多代理框架，具有兩個不同的管道：(1) 驗證管道檢測並自我修正 OpenAPI 語法錯誤，(2) 市場分析管道進行競爭研究，識別與行業領導者之間的功能差距，並自動生成缺失的 API 規範功能。我們在兩個精心策劃的 API 規範數據集上評估了 Agent4Spec，這些數據集涵蓋了通用和工業場景。在 9 個最先進的 LLM 中，表現最佳的模型達到了 100% 的語法錯誤檢測率和超過 95% 的修正實施成功率，同時對建議的端點改進的採用率超過 50%，代表了 API 開發的一個實用工具。
